name: Rotator Cuff Tear
definition: Structural tearing of one or more rotator cuff tendons, ranging from partial-thickness injury to full-thickness tears and massive cuff deficiency.

typical: Traumatic onset may cause sudden weakness

investigations.principle: Diagnosis combines clinical weakness with imaging when required.
investigations.MRI: Ultrasound or MRI defines tear size, retraction and muscle quality.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs assess arthritis, acromial morphology and other bony disease.

green: Education and progressive rehabilitation for many degenerative tears
Pain control and scapular/rotator cuff strengthening
amber: Acute traumatic tears, major weakness or failed rehabilitation may require early orthopedic surgical assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa/Snayu phenotype may be documented; tendon disruption remains a modern structural diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Structural tearing of one or more rotator cuff tendons, ranging from partial-thickness injury to full-thickness tears and massive cuff deficiency.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
